remarks: Nestled in the desirable Huntington Woods subdivision, this beautifully maintained 4-bedroom, 3-full-bath home offers the perfect blend of space, comfort, and timeless style. The thoughtfully designed floor plan creates an inviting flow that's ideal for both everyday living and entertaining. Step inside to a welcoming foyer, where a formal dining room provides the perfect setting for special gatherings. Just beyond, a spacious den offers endless flexibility as a home office, library, or additional sitting area. Continue into the heart of the home, where the spacious kitchen features abundant cabinetry, a center island, and plenty of workspace for preparing meals. Sliding doors lead to the expansive Trex deck, creating a seamless transition to outdoor entertaining while overlooking the beautifully landscaped backyard. The kitchen flows effortlessly into the inviting family room, where a beautiful gas fireplace creates a warm focal point for relaxing evenings. An additional formal living room provides even more space for entertaining or unwinding. Hardwood and tile flooring extend throughout the main living areas, adding warmth and timeless appeal. The main level also includes a convenient first-floor laundry room complete with a utility sink and additional storage, along with a full bathroom featuring a large walk-in shower. Upstairs, an open hallway overlooks the foyer below, enhancing the home's bright and airy feel. All four bedrooms are located on the second level, including the spacious primary suite featuring a large walk-in closet and a private bath with double vanities, a walk-in shower, and a relaxing Jacuzzi tub. A third full bathroom with a tub and shower combination comfortably serves the remaining bedrooms. The full unfinished basement offers endless possibilities for a recreation room, home gym, or abundant storage. Completing the property is a three-car attached garage with an attached convenient rear overhead door, making it easy to access lawn equipment and outdoor tools. Outside, enjoy the beautifully landscaped grounds, a storage shed, and the expansive Trex deck—the perfect setting for entertaining or simply relaxing in your private backyard.
